party animal.meaning: Người nghiện tiệc tùng, dân quẩy.
party animal.example: John is such a party animal; he’s out every weekend.

pass the buck.example: The manager was known to pass the buck whenever something went wrong.

pass the course.meaning: Vượt qua khóa học, thi đậu.
pass the course.example: She studied really hard and finally passed the course with flying colors.

pay a pretty penny.meaning: Trả một khoản tiền lớn, tốn kha khá tiền.
pay a pretty penny.example: He paid a pretty penny for that vintage car.

pay an arm and a leg.term: Pay an arm and a leg
pay an arm and a leg.meaning: Trả một cái giá cắt cổ, tốn rất nhiều tiền.
pay an arm and a leg.example: He had to pay an arm and a leg for that rare book.

pay the piper.meaning: Gánh chịu hậu quả, trả giá.
pay the piper.example: After years of ignoring his health, he had to pay the piper with a long hospital stay.

pay through the nose.meaning: Bị chặt chém, phải trả giá trên trời.
pay through the nose.example: We had to pay through the nose for those concert tickets.

paddle your own canoe.meaning: Tự lực cánh sinh, tự đứng trên đôi chân của mình.
paddle your own canoe.example: After graduating from college, he decided to paddle his own canoe and start his own business.

pay up.meaning: Trả hết nợ, thanh toán sòng phẳng (sau khi bị nhắc nhở).
pay up.example: After weeks of reminders, he finally agreed to pay up his debt.

pass with flying colors.meaning: Đậu xuất sắc, vượt qua kỳ thi với kết quả rực rỡ.
pass with flying colors.example: He studied diligently every evening and passed the bar exam with flying colors.

pale as a ghost.meaning: Mặt mày tái mét như ma (do quá sợ hãi, sốc hoặc ốm nặng).
pale as a ghost.example: When he heard the shocking news, his face turned as pale as a ghost.
